mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 10.0% over a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases the risk of recession and triggers a flight to safety, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 10.0%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 98.0 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals a weakening economy and reduces corporate profitability, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO remains below 98.0, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) combined with a rising housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and confidence, which boosts corporate revenue expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST rise, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 215.0 for two consecutive months signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to maintain or raise rates, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 215.0, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and a rise in unemployment (UNRATE) signals labor market weakening, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction effect has a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past four quarters signals a deepening recession, which reduces corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 is contracting, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
